remediationCycle5.//TR: PS1B-C4-001 düzeltmesi: focus.js odak taşımayı activeElement ile doğrular ve odak alamayan adayda (devre dışı, display:none boş .form-status, tabindex'siz kap) sıradakine geçer; yoklama boş durum bloğunda önce durum satırını dener. call-site audit (no further code change needed once takeFocus is verified): repaintStatus already orders state first when empty; runAction/openPreview keys list the control, then status (always non-empty at that point), then studio-run-state; wizard/import/export/executors use focusResult (status set before rerender, then settle with fall-through keys); files/diff/tabs/back keys fall through to data-focus-first or #view-title (studio-panel and panel h2 titles have no tabindex and are now skipped instead of 'succeeding'); confirm dialog returns focus to a connected, enabled invoker and the caller then settles; renderRoute safety net (restoreFocus -> focusLost -> settleFocus with PANEL_FOCUS_FALLBACK) now falls through when the restored status is empty. app.js unchanged
